evidence.reason: The current renderer finds a single line beginning with `ExecStart=` and replaces only that physical line. Systemd permits directive continuation, so a wrapped `ExecStart` with trailing `\` would pass the one-match check but leave the old continuation lines in the generated unit while the returned `exec_start` reflects the new command. This is a routine implementation defect in the existing replacement behavior; consume continuation lines or reject wrapped `ExecStart` directives.
